# iosxe_redundancy_application_group (Data Source)

This data source can read the Redundancy Application Group configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_redundancy_application_group" "example" {
  group_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) rg group id

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `control_interface` (String) Interface to be used as RG control interface
- `control_protocol` (Number) RG group protocol media
- `data_interface` (String) RG group data interface
- `failover_threshold` (Number) Failover Threshold
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `name` (String) name string (25 chars. max)
- `preempt` (Boolean) RG group preempt
- `priority` (Number) Priority value
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Shutdown the selected group
- `timers_delay` (Number) RG group delay timer. value in seconds
- `timers_reload` (Number) RG group reload timer. Value in seconds
- `tracks` (Attributes List) RG group tracking (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tracks))

<a id="nestedatt--tracks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tracks`

Read-Only:

- `decrement` (Number) Decrement Value
- `object_number` (String) Tracked object number
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Shutdown group
